verdict: Evo-Revamped outperforms the legacy Evo system by 120.3% on the composite evaluation metric, driven by its multi-source retrieval architecture (Tavily + GDELT + Common Crawl), NLI-based perspective clustering (4 distinct viewpoints vs Evo's 1), and source diversity spanning 2 independent retrieval channels — structural capabilities entirely absent in the legacy system.
